title: Fix a broken load
objectives: Find the rows a retried, append-only load doubled
Rebuild a Silver table with one row per key, the latest version
Write a load that leaves the same table however many times it runs

exercises.prompt: Find every order_id that appears more than once in silver_orders: order_id and copies, smallest order_id first.
Rebuild silver_orders with one row per order, its latest load (by loaded_at), and end with SELECT order_id, status, amount FROM silver_orders ORDER BY order_id.
hints: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_orders AS SELECT ... FROM silver_orders replaces the table with your query's rows.
row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY loaded_at DESC) = 1 keeps each order's latest row (LM-06).

exercises.prompt: Load src_orders_day3 into silver_clean so that running the load twice leaves one row per order. Write the load twice in your answer, then SELECT order_id, status, amount FROM silver_clean ORDER BY order_id.
hints: INSERT adds rows every time it runs. Which statement updates the rows that are already there and inserts only the new ones?
MERGE INTO silver_clean AS t USING src_orders_day3 AS s ON t.order_id = s.order_id, then WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ... WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ...
Set status, amount and loaded_at when it matches, and insert all four columns when it doesn't.
